capabilities: Track initiative order with next/previous round navigation
Create PC, NPC, and vehicle combat sheets
Apply hits, stun and death saves, ammo, and speedware to combatants
Insert combat-sheet template blocks into notes that add combatants to the tracker
extras: Unofficial fan tool, not affiliated with R. Talsorian Games or CD Projekt. Not yet in the community directory; can be installed manually from GitHub releases. Runs on mobile but layouts are cramped. All data stays local with no network use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run tabletop RPG combat encounters, so Cyberpunk 2020 players must track initiative and combatant state outside their vault.
summary: Combat tracker for Cyberpunk 2020 that manages initiative, combatant sheets, hit and damage resolution, and status effects in a sidebar.
